hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.env.example) exit 0;; *.env|*.env.*) echo 'BLOCKED: .env 受保護(帝國規則:.env 永不進 git / 不可手改)。要改設定請編輯 .env.example。' >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$c" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|])[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+push'; then echo "$c" | grep -Eq '(--force|[[:space:]]-f([[:space:]]|$)|(^|[[:space:]:/])(main|master)([[:space:]:]|$))' && { echo 'BLOCKED: 禁止 push main/master 或 force push(帝國規則)。' >&2; exit 2; }; fi; exit 0

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); echo "$c" | grep -Eq '(>>?|tee([[:space:]]+-a)?)[[:space:]]*([^[:space:];|&]*/)?[.]env([.](local|production|prod|development|dev|staging|stage|test|secret|secrets))?([^.a-zA-Z0-9]|$)' && { echo 'BLOCKED: 禁止用 Bash 寫入 .env(帝國規則:.env 永不進 git)。改設定請編輯 .env.example。' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.py ]] && /home/user/cliproxyapi-config/.venv/bin/ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; } || true

sudo service postgresql start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; pg_isready >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '✅ PG up' || echo '⚠️ PG down — run: sudo service postgresql start'; grep -q 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-' /home/user/cliproxyapi-config/.env 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ API key set' || echo '⚠️ ANTHROPIC_API_KEY missing — DevSwarm unavailable until you fill .env'
